data_point: Recently converted from an LLC to a Delaware C-Corporation
run_when: An older snapshot of the site or registry results are available.

prompt.task: Decide whether the company recently converted from an LLC to a Delaware C-Corporation or reincorporated in Delaware.
prompt.definition: The standard step before an institutional round, and the moment the books get formalised. Recent means within about 12 months.
yes_when: An older site version or filing shows 'LLC' and the current one shows a Delaware 'Inc.'
News or a filing describes the conversion
no_when: The company has been a Delaware corporation for years
watch_out_for: A name change alone is not a conversion
where_to_look: Old snapshots of the footer and terms

evidence_quote.description: Exact words copied from the text. Empty when the answer is unknown.

source.description: Page name or URL the quote came from.

reason.description: One plain sentence explaining the answer.
